meta.hmm: 2-state Gaussian HMM (hmmlearn), last 250 NY-close daily log returns before the session, high-variance-state probability at the last close; label RANGE/TREND = variance, as hmm.js. Travel = position in 63-bar range + efficiency vs random walk, as travelRead.js

range_model.note: lrv = log of (last 10 days realised vol / last 250 days) = how hot the market has been running; gneg = 1 on a BREAKOUT (short-gamma) day; reinf = 1 if the hedge-flow slope is reinforcing; ivz = how rich the options are for that market (z-score)
